## Key Projects
- **MobileCare Queuing**: Real-time queue management system for an Apple Authorized Service Provider (AASP) featuring kiosk intake, live dispatching, and WebSockets.
- **Lead to Cash Portal**: Digital waiver and lead management platform for Power Mac Center and The Loop.
- **PMCIE LMS**: Web-based Learning Management System for PMC Institute for Excellence with automated batch scheduling, curriculum tracking, and analytics dashboards.
- **Basecamp TMS**: Training Monitoring System streamlining scheduling, evaluation, and role-based training records.
- **WMedLaw DTR**: Daily Time Record and payroll system for WMedLaw built with Next.js and Supabase.
- **WMedLaw Web Platform**: Official website and client intake portal for a Texas-based law firm.
- **Nexus-IMS**: Enterprise Inventory Management System with multi-warehouse tracking and gatekeeper approval workflows.
- **SWFS**: HRIS and payroll solution with BIR tax, alphalist, and last pay computation.
- **SPOTT**: Mobile Daily Time Record (DTR) and attendance tracking application built with Ionic, Vue, and REST APIs.

## Side & IoT Projects
- **Juala De Amor**: IoT smart bird cage system (Android, Arduino, Firebase).
- **ReCSys**: Automated smart clothes-drying system (Android, Arduino, Firebase).
- **QuickCharge-Fi**: Student charging and Wi-Fi station (Android, Arduino, PHP, MySQL).
